lines.text: Barnaby the big brown bear stomped his giant paws into the forest bakery!
Hand over the warm cinnamon honey rolls right now! Barnaby bellowed loudly!
Mrs. Badger folded her apron and clicked the glass display counter shut!
Barnaby huffed and puffed, trying to push through, but the latch wouldn't budge!
Little Robin chirped from the counter, Roaring only builds walls, Barnaby!
Barnaby looked down at his big clumsy paws. He took a breath and whispered...
May I please have a honey roll, Mrs. Badger? I appreciate your hard work!
CLICK! The door swung wide open with a warm smile—magic words open every heart!
Speak with kindness and respect—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
